label: Uneasy
summary: A grim week ends with one narrow opening. Trump dispatched envoys Witkoff and Kushner to Moscow and Kyiv this weekend with a new peace plan — the first real movement in months — even as Russia's jet-powered drones killed dozens in Ukraine and Trump repeated his threat to strike Iran's Pickaxe Mountain 'very soon'. Malaysia declared a state of emergency in Sarawak as Indonesian wildfire haze turned the air hazardous and closed 647 schools. Explosions at a Bolivian military base near La Paz killed at least ten. Tunisia arrested another journalist. The economy split: US payrolls rose 162,000 in August, far above forecasts, but diesel hit an all-time high on Iran war disruption. Brighter notes were small and real — two Nepali workers pulled alive from a flooded tunnel after nine days, and the UN voting to adopt a world map showing Africa's true size.
